newsitem.title: SWEDEN: INSTANT VIEW-Analysts' views on Swedish co moves.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW-Analysts' views on Swedish co moves.

text.p: Following are some analysts' views on changes announced in the Swedish corporate sector early Monday.
The head of Swedish vehicle maker AB Volvo, Soren Gyll, is retiring but staying on the board and will be replaced by Electrolux chief executive Leif Johansson.
Industrial engineer Atlas Copco's managing director, Michael Treschow, is to replace Johansson and in turn will be replaced by the company's Giulio Mazzalupi.

"Gyll was the architect of the re-engineering of Volvo post the Renault break up. He is seen above all by investors as a great deal maker and closely associated with everything to do with this new strategy.
"I think investors will look closely to see if they can detect any change in attitude from the management.
"But as regards trading implications, the fact that it is planned with successors announced should limit moves. Johansson is an eminently respectable replacement.
"The fact that Gyll is staying on the board means that people will not assume any change in strategy."
